question: In the Police Retirement System of St. Louis (PRS-STL) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the principal actuary have?
gold_answer: A minimum of five years of professional actuarial experience, plus a minimum of five years of experience testifying before legislative and administrative bodies.
acceptance: Five years professional actuarial experience is the core number. A complete description may state the separate five-year testimony requirement; these are not additive ten years and may overlap. Credentials are optional for this question.
candidate_answer: The principal actuary must have **at least five years of professional actuarial experience**. The RFP also requires five years of experience testifying before legislative or administrative bodies. [PRS-STL actuarial RFP, p. 8]
